column1: # bios-r2-x006.tsv -- DUMPBIOS disk round, closing table for BIOS-STOR-006:
# sectors per FAT 0, then logical Rwabs (probe cases X07, X08,
# measurements/measurement-2026-10-28-bios-storage-audit/method/bstprobe.c;
# docs/audits/2026-10-28-bios-storage.md), against EmuTOS 1a7484ab
# (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md; TASK/TOOL07).  EmuTOS refuses the BPB as FAT32 and
# marks recsiz 0 (bios/blkdev.c:736-741); a logical Rwabs then answers ESECNF
# WHERE IT RUNS -- as bios-r2.tsv: the oracle's profile disk
# (HATARI_ORACLE_DISK=<test.img> tools/hatari-oracle.sh disk ...) and on NewTOS
# a card from tools/mkcard.sh with MKCARD_TESTDISK (cargo xtask tosdump bios
# --disk ...). The test image: tools/mktestdisk.sh
# NEWDESK.INF=<inf>, the one of bios-r2.tsv (sha256 d95a60c3...); C: = LBA 63,
# DESTRUCTIVE ("!disk 2 destructive", docs/TOS-REFERENCE-DUMPER.md section 6,
# "The closing tables"): the table changes C:'s boot sector and ends with it
# changed -- on EmuTOS a failed Getbpb leaves recsiz 0 (bios/blkdev.c:601),
# after which no logical Rwabs reaches the disk (blkdev.c:443-444), so there is
# no logical way back.  It runs on a fresh clone of the test image only (the
# runners refuse otherwise), and both sides must END in the same state: the
# test partitions after the run are compared (RUNINFO of the run).
#   +set <TAB> <offset>=<byte>,...  changes the buffer the read prelude right
#   before it filled; the write after it writes "read + set" back.
#   End state: C:'s boot sector with spf 0 (bytes 0x16, 0x17 = 0), every other
#   byte of the test partition unchanged.
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!disk

column5: Getbpb(2) before: the image's BPB -- blkdev.c:569-777

column1: # ---- the patch: sectors per FAT 128 -> 0
+set

column5: X07 write the patched boot sector, RW_NOMEDIACH -- blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
X07a Mediach(2) after it: forcechange -- blkdev.c:799-803
X07b Getbpb(2) -> 0: fsiz 0, recsiz marked 0 -- blkdev.c:736-741
X07c Mediach(2) after the failed Getbpb -- blkdev.c:589-590, 783-820
X08a read sector 0, RW_NOMEDIACH: ESECNF -- blkdev.c:443-444
X08b read the last sector: ESECNF -- blkdev.c:443-444
X08c count 0: ESECNF before the range check -- blkdev.c:443-444
X08e read sector 1 again: ESECNF -- blkdev.c:443-444
